I've very recently been diagnosed with Adult ADHD & I'm about to embark on the final year of my bachelor's degree. I would love to hear tips and techniques other people are or have used to get higher marks and maximise learning.

My current "tricks" are as follows:

  • If I have a 2-hour or more gap, hit the gym between lectures. Doesn't have to be long, just burn through energy

  • Record lectures if allowed, in addition to note-taking. (I haven't started yet, but trying this out when I start again)

  • Use a timer when doing fun, hobby things before having finished all the uni work. You can fully engage in it without checking the time, but also avoid having spent 4 hours where you meant to spend 1.
